task_description.overview: Filter a seismogram using a zero-phase bandpass filter and compute its envelope for visualization and further analysis.
steps: Load the seismic waveform data from the specified URL or file.
Extract the raw data array, number of points, and sampling rate from the trace metadata.
Apply a zero-phase bandpass filter with given corner frequencies and number of corners.
Compute the envelope of the filtered data using a Hilbert transform or equivalent method.
Generate a time vector and plot both the filtered waveform and its envelope over the desired time window.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the seismic trace from the URL {seismic_waveform_url}. Apply a zero-phase bandpass filter with freqmin={freqmin} Hz, freqmax={freqmax} Hz, corners={corners}. Compute the envelope of the filtered data. Visualize the filtered waveform and its envelope between {time_window}[0] s and {time_window}[1] s. Save the filtered data envelope to {filtered_data_envelope}.
